HomePage.faqDescription: Everything you need to know about ordering, delivery, payments, and more.
HomePage.faq1Question: What can I order through this platform?
HomePage.faq1Answer: Order food from restaurants, groceries, and pharmacy & beauty items — all from one app, delivered to your door.
HomePage.faq2Answer: Delivery fees are set per restaurant or store based on your distance from them, not a flat citywide rate — you'll always see the exact fee before you check out.
HomePage.faq3Question: What payment methods do you accept?
HomePage.faq3Answer: We support card and mobile payments through Stripe, Paystack, and Flutterwave — the right option is offered automatically based on your currency and country.
HomePage.faq4Question: Can I track my order in real time?
HomePage.faq4Answer: Yes — once a rider picks up your order, you can watch it move toward you on a live map from the order detail page.
HomePage.faq5Answer: A delivered or cancelled order with a successful payment is eligible for a refund; our team reviews each request and processes it back to your original payment method.
HomePage.faq6Answer: Restaurants and stores are paid out weekly, not per order — earnings from the week are transferred to their connected bank account every Monday.
HomePage.faq7Question: How do I start selling on the platform?
HomePage.faq7Answer: Tap "Register your business" to apply as a restaurant or store owner; you'll need to complete a short verification (KYC) step before you can go live.
HomePage.faq8Question: How do I become a delivery rider?
HomePage.faq8Answer: Apply from the "Become a rider" link — after your documents are verified, you can start accepting deliveries near you.
HomePage.faq9Answer: Yes — we never see or store your full card details. Payments are handled entirely by our PCI-compliant payment providers.
HomePage.faq10Question: What if something's wrong with my order?
HomePage.faq10Answer: Use the support chat in the bottom-right corner of any page, or contact us from your account — we're here to help sort it out.
HomePage.faq11Question: Can I use the app in my own language?
HomePage.faq11Answer: Yes — switch between six languages at any time using the language selector in the header.
HomePage.faq12Question: Do I need an account to get help?
HomePage.faq12Answer: No — the support chat works for guests too, and your conversation is saved for the length of your visit even if you're not signed in.

TermsPage.title: Terms & Conditions
TermsPage.templateNotice: This page is a template that reflects this platform's actual technical behavior (how payments, refunds, payouts, and data are actually handled) rather than generic boilerplate — but it is not legal advice. Before relying on it for a real business, please have it reviewed by a qualified lawyer in your jurisdiction.
TermsPage.metaDescription: Read the terms and conditions for using this platform as a customer, vendor, or delivery rider.
TermsPage.section1Body: By creating an account, placing an order, registering as a vendor or rider, or otherwise using this platform, you agree to these Terms & Conditions. These terms apply to every type of account on the platform: customers, restaurant and store owners ("vendors"), and delivery riders. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.
TermsPage.section2Body: This platform is a technology marketplace that connects customers with independent restaurants, independent grocery and pharmacy stores ("vendors"), and independent delivery riders. We provide the ordering, payment, and delivery-coordination technology — we are not the seller of any food, grocery, or pharmacy item, and vendors and riders are not our employees. Each vendor is solely responsible for the food and items they list; each rider is solely responsible for how they carry out a delivery.
TermsPage.section3Body: You must be able to form a legally binding contract in your country to create an account, and must provide accurate registration information. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential and for all activity on your account. We may suspend or terminate an account that violates these terms, provides false information, or is used fraudulently.
TermsPage.section4Body: Prices, availability, and opening hours are set and maintained by each vendor and may differ from what's available in person. Delivery fees are calculated per delivery zone, based on distance from the vendor, and are shown in full before you confirm an order. An order is only confirmed once payment has succeeded — placing an order is an offer to purchase, which the vendor may decline (for example if an item has just sold out).
TermsPage.section5Body: Payments are processed by our third-party payment providers — Stripe, Paystack, or Flutterwave, selected automatically based on your currency — and we never store your full card number. Every payment status shown to you (successful, failed, refunded) is confirmed directly by the provider; a payment is never marked successful based only on what your device reports. Promo codes are subject to their own terms shown at the time you apply them.
TermsPage.section6Body: Restaurants and stores keep the majority of each order's subtotal; the platform retains a commission (currently 15%) to operate the marketplace, and delivery riders keep 100% of the delivery fee for each order they complete. Vendor and rider earnings are paid out weekly, in a single batch, to the bank account they've connected — not per individual order. A payout can fail if connected bank details are missing or incorrect; when that happens, we tell the vendor or rider what to fix so the next batch succeeds.
TermsPage.section7Body: An order can be cancelled before a vendor accepts it. Once delivered, or once cancelled after payment has succeeded, an order may be eligible for a refund; our team reviews refund requests and, where approved, returns the payment to your original payment method. Refund timing after approval depends on your payment provider and bank, typically a few business days.
TermsPage.section8Body: Estimated delivery times are our best estimate, not a guarantee — they can be affected by traffic, weather, order volume, and vendor preparation time. Delivery zones, maximum delivery distance, and fees are configured individually by each vendor. Where a vendor has scheduled ordering enabled, orders are only accepted during their published opening hours.
TermsPage.section9Body: Vendors agree to: list accurate, up-to-date menu or catalog items and prices; complete our identity and compliance verification (KYC) before going live, and keep any required documents current; fulfil accepted orders promptly and as described; and comply with all food-safety, health, licensing, and consumer-protection laws that apply to their business in their own jurisdiction.
TermsPage.section10Body: Riders agree to: complete identity verification (KYC) before accepting deliveries; carry out deliveries safely and in compliance with local traffic and road-safety laws; handle food and items with reasonable care during transport; and keep their availability status accurate so customers aren't matched with a rider who isn't actually available.
TermsPage.section11Body: You may not: use the platform for any fraudulent purpose, including fake orders, fake reviews, or payment fraud; attempt to pay a vendor or rider outside the platform to avoid fees; upload false or altered verification documents; harass or threaten another user, vendor, or rider; or attempt to interfere with the platform's security or normal operation.
TermsPage.section12Body: Reviews may only be left by a customer for an order they actually placed and must reflect a genuine experience. We may remove any review or other content that violates these terms, is fraudulent, or is unlawful, and may suspend the account responsible for repeated violations.
TermsPage.section13Body: The platform is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis. We are not responsible for the quality, safety, or preparation of food or items sold by a vendor, or for a rider's conduct during delivery, beyond what applicable law requires of a marketplace operator — each vendor and rider is independently responsible for their own goods and services. To the fullest extent permitted by law, our liability for any claim relating to your use of the platform is limited to the amount you paid for the order giving rise to the claim.
TermsPage.section14Body: We may suspend or terminate any account — customer, vendor, or rider — that violates these terms, engages in fraudulent activity, or repeatedly fails to meet compliance obligations (such as keeping KYC documents current). You may stop using the platform and close your account at any time from your account settings.
TermsPage.section15Body: We may update these terms from time to time to reflect changes to the platform or applicable law. Continuing to use the platform after an update constitutes acceptance of the revised terms. If you have questions about these terms, you can reach us through the support chat available on every page, or from your account.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.templateNotice: This page is a template that reflects this platform's actual technical behavior (what data we collect and how it's used) rather than generic boilerplate — but it is not legal advice. Before relying on it for a real business, please have it reviewed by a qualified lawyer in your jurisdiction.
PrivacyPage.metaDescription: Learn what information this platform collects, how it's used, and the choices you have.
PrivacyPage.section1Body: This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have — whether you're a customer, a vendor, a rider, or a guest using our support chat without an account.
PrivacyPage.section2Body: Account information you provide (name, email, phone number, delivery addresses); order history and preferences; payment metadata such as the payment provider used and transaction status — never your full card number, which is handled entirely by our payment providers; identity and compliance documents submitted by vendors and riders for verification; location data, where you enable it; and messages you send through the support chat, including a generated session id if you use it as a guest.
PrivacyPage.section3Body: We use your information to: process and fulfil your orders and payments; coordinate delivery and show you live tracking; verify vendor and rider identity and compliance; respond to support requests, including through the chat widget; send order, account, and (where you've enabled them) marketing notifications by email, SMS, or push notification; and maintain and improve the platform.
PrivacyPage.section4Body: With your permission, we use your device's location to calculate accurate delivery fees for your area, show you nearby restaurants and stores ("Near me"), and display a live map of your order's delivery progress. Location access is always requested by your browser, never collected silently, and is never sold.
PrivacyPage.section5Body: We use your browser's local storage for two narrow purposes: remembering your light/dark theme preference, and, if you use the support chat without an account, a randomly generated session id so your conversation can be reloaded if you return. We don't use third-party advertising trackers.
PrivacyPage.section6Body: We share the minimum information needed for a vendor and rider to fulfil your order (such as your delivery address and items ordered); with our payment providers (Stripe, Paystack, Flutterwave) to process payments; and with our email and SMS providers to deliver notifications you're entitled to receive. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
PrivacyPage.section7Body: We keep your account and order data for as long as your account is active, and afterward for as long as needed to meet accounting, tax, and legal obligations. Support chat history and tickets are kept to help us improve the knowledge base and follow up on unresolved questions.
PrivacyPage.section8Body: You can view and update most of your account information directly from your account page, and request deletion of your account there or by contacting support. If you used the support chat as a guest, clearing your browser's local storage removes your locally-stored session id.
PrivacyPage.section9Body: This platform is not directed at, and should not be used by, anyone under 16 years old. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children, and accounts may not be created on a minor's behalf.
PrivacyPage.section10Body: Depending on where our hosting and payment infrastructure is located, your information may be processed in a country other than the one you're in. Where this happens, we rely on our providers' own safeguards for handling data across borders.
PrivacyPage.section11Body: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information, including never storing raw payment card details ourselves and verifying every payment status directly with the payment provider rather than trusting a client-reported result. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we can't guarantee absolute security.
PrivacyPage.section12Title: Changes to this policy and contact
PrivacyPage.section12Body: We may update this policy from time to time; the date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision. If you have questions about this policy or how your information is handled, you can reach us through the support chat available on every page, or from your account.
